text:
58 PRs merged this week. Community models now look more like a publishing surface and less like a drawer of mysterious IDs. The image stack got new pipes, guards, and exits; the catalog learned some manners; and one HTTP call can now produce a few more kinds of thing.

Also: timeouts can leave politely now. Small mercy. 🌿

Details are in the repo: github.com/pollinations/pollinations
